rawContent: I request you to provide us with the space in which we will be heard. We never found courage to express ourselves until the #MeToo movement galvanised by honesty of a few, gave us confidence to speak & compelled our countrymen and women to listen to us.

Despite, some women enablers desperately trying to discredit #metoo, the avalanche of allegations and the rush for correction in the workplace proves something significant has changed, writes @bainjal https://t.co/To2I1uzxEh
There's a thin line and a blurred one between #Sympathy and #Justice. Women looking for the latter need to negotiate it carefully. I'm at the inflection too. #MeToo @farabruiser @DhrutiMKapadia
